nuke.description: Remove what is already indexed. True by default and the reason this endpoint exists: adding to the list only stops future indexing. Pass false to pre-emptively block something that has not been indexed yet.

value.description: What to deny. The kind is DERIVED from this value and is never supplied by the caller: did: is a repository, at:// is one record, http:// or https:// is a PDS endpoint, and a canonical CIDv1 is a blob. A value matching none of the four is a 400 rather than a guess.

comment.description: Free-text moderation note. Not the audit field: who performed the action is taken from the administrative credential and recorded separately, because a moderation log has to answer 'who removed this and when' as a queryable field rather than as a convention about comment text.

errors.name: UnknownKind
errors.description: The value is not a DID, an AT-URI, an http(s) endpoint, or a canonical CIDv1.

errors.name: AdminDisabled
errors.description: No administrative credential is configured, so the administrative surface does not exist.

kind.description: The kind derived from the value.

nuked.description: Rows removed from the appview. Zero when nuke was false.

repos.description: Repositories emptied. One for a did nuke; zero or more for a pds nuke.

value.description: The value as stored. A PDS endpoint is normalized to one spelling, so this may differ from the input.

main.description: Add a value to the appview's denylist and, by default, remove what it has already indexed. Requires the administrative credential. Adding to the list stops future indexing; nuking removes what is already there, which is why nuke defaults to true.
